fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6VY7H (Autonomy per workflow). No owner took part. The planner read the autonomy code (autonomyStage in internal/api/autonomy.go, the daemon's plan, ship and signoff reads in request.go and daemon.go, the accept read at the plan gate, the milestone hard-codes in daemonStartPlan and run start's --autonomous refusal) and raised three questions: what the change set serves with no open milestone, which workflow's declaration governs each stage, and how milestone planning gets its owner-only default. The arbiter answered all three in Decision autonomy-per-workflow-scope: serve no milestone and wait on scheduling as policy (01M6VY7GRV); each stage takes its autonomy from the workflow of the run that performs it, falling back to rhiza.autonomy.<stage>; milestone planning gets a built-in plan-milestone workflow declaring autonomous = false and the hard-code goes. The planner then wrote six leaves: the declaration in the workflow file, stage resolution in the daemon and runs, the run record and run status showing each stage's source, health listing declaring workflows, the plan-milestone built-in replacing the milestone hard-codes, and the end-to-end bugfix check, which needs workflow dispatch (01M6VY7G6H).
fields.title: Autonomy per workflow: autonomous plan interview, answered by the arbiter
